```{r libraries_data}
# LOAD LIBRARIES AND IMPORT DATA
library(tidyverse)    # Core data science suite: dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, readr etc.
library(janitor)      # Data cleaning (clean_names, etc.)
library(gtsummary)    # Generate summary tables (supports LaTeX output)
library(kableExtra)   # Enhanced table formatting (supports booktabs, striped LaTeX options)

# DATA IMPORT
# Using show_col_types=FALSE suppresses column type messages
genes_data <- read_csv("QBS103_GSE157103_genes.csv",
                       show_col_types = FALSE)
series_matrix <- read_csv("QBS103_GSE157103_series_matrix.csv",
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r data_cleaning}
# DATA CLEANING AND PREPARATION
series_matrix_clean <- series_matrix %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    ## Age processing
    age_years = case_when(
      !is.na(age) & str_detect(age, "^>\\s*89") ~ 90,  # Handle ">89" cases
      TRUE ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(age, "\\d+")))
    ),
    ## Gender standardization
    sex = str_to_title(str_trim(sex)),
    ## ICU status factor
    icu_status = factor(icu_status,
                        levels = c("no", "yes"),
                        labels = c("Non-ICU", "ICU")),
    ## CRP cleaning
    crp_mg_l = na_if(crp_mg_l, "unknown"),
    crp_mg_l = readr::parse_number(as.character(crp_mg_l)),
    ## Disease classification
    disease_status = if_else(str_detect(disease_status, "COVID-19"),
                             "COVID-19", "Non-COVID-19")
  )

# Variable classification
cont_vars <- c("age_years", "crp_mg_l")  # Continuous variables
cat_vars  <- c("sex", "disease_status")  # Categorical variables

# Prepare table data
tab_df <- series_matrix_clean %>%
  select(icu_status, all_of(cont_vars), all_of(cat_vars))

# GENERATE SUMMARY TABLE
tbl <- tbl_summary(
  data = tab_df,
  by = icu_status,  # Stratify by ICU status
  statistic = list(
    all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",            # Categorical format
    age_years ~ "{mean} ({sd}); {median} [{p25}, {p75}]",  # Continuous format
    crp_mg_l  ~ "{mean} ({sd}); {median} [{p25}, {p75}]"
  ),
  label = list(  # Improved labels with type indication
    age_years      ~ "Age (years) (Continuous)",
    crp_mg_l       ~ "CRP (mg/L) (Continuous)",
    sex            ~ "Sex (Categorical)",
    disease_status ~ "Disease status (Categorical)"
  ),
  missing_text = "Missing"  # Explicit missing data handling
) %>%
  add_n() %>%  # Add sample size column
  add_p(test = list(  # Statistical tests
    all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test",
    all_continuous()  ~ "wilcox.test"
  )) %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%  # Format header
  bold_labels()  # Emphasize labels

# PREVIEW IN RSTUDIO
tbl  # Display HTML table in Viewer
```

## Publication Quality Visualizations

```{r publication_plots}
# PUBLICATION-QUALITY PLOTS
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)

# REIMPORT DATA FOR FRESH START
genes_data   <- read_csv("QBS103_GSE157103_genes.csv",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)
series_matrix <- read_csv("QBS103_GSE157103_series_matrix.csv",
                          show_col_types = FALSE)

# RESHAPE GENE DATA TO LONG FORMAT
expr_long <- genes_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -1,
    names_to  = "participant_id",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  rename(gene = 1)

# CLEAN METADATA
meta_df <- series_matrix %>%
  rename(crp = `crp(mg/l)`) %>%
  mutate(
    crp        = parse_number(crp),
    sex        = factor(str_trim(sex)),
    icu_status = factor(str_trim(icu_status),
                        levels = c("no", "yes"),
                        labels = c("No ICU", "ICU"))
  ) %>%
  select(participant_id, crp, sex, icu_status)

# PLOTTING FUNCTION DEFINITION
plot_gene_plots <- function(data, gene_list,
                            cont_var, cat_var1, cat_var2) {
  # Filter and clean data
  df <- data %>%
    filter(gene %in% gene_list) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(c(cont_var, cat_var1, cat_var2)))
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) stop("No data to plot: check gene names or covariates.")
  
  # Generate plots for each gene
  for (g in gene_list) {
    sub <- df %>% filter(gene == g)
    
    # 1. HISTOGRAM WITH DENSITY
    p_hist <- ggplot(sub, aes(x = expression)) +
      geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..),
                     bins = 30, fill = "#2c7fb8",
                     color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
      geom_density(color = "#08306b", size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE)),
                 color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
      annotate("text",
               x = mean(sub$expression, na.rm = TRUE),
               y = 0,
               label = paste0("Mean = ",
                              round(mean(sub$expression, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
               vjust = -1, hjust = 0, color = "red", size = 4) +
      labs(title = paste("Distribution of", g, "Expression"),
           x     = paste(g, "Expression"),
           y     = "Density") +
      theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text  = element_text(color = "black")
      )
    print(p_hist)
    
    # 2. SCATTERPLOT WITH TRENDLINE
    p_scatter <- ggplot(sub,
                        aes_string(x     = cont_var,
                                   y     = "expression",
                                   color = cat_var1,
                                   shape = cat_var2)) +
      geom_point(size  = 2.8, alpha = 0.75) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE,
                  linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30", size = 0.8) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(g, " Expression vs ", toupper(cont_var)),
        subtitle = paste("Colored by", tools::toTitleCase(cat_var1),
                         "and shaped by ICU Status"),
        x     = paste0(tools::toTitleCase(cont_var), " (mg/L)"),
        y     = paste(g, "Expression"), 
        color = tools::toTitleCase(cat_var1),
        shape = "ICU Status"
      ) +
      scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +  # Colorblind-friendly palette
      scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17)) +  # Distinct shapes
      theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, color = "gray30"),
        legend.position = "right"
      )
    print(p_scatter)
    
    # 3. BOXPLOT WITH JITTER
    p_box <- ggplot(sub,
                    aes_string(x    = cat_var1,
                               y    = "expression",
                               fill = cat_var2)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1, alpha = 0.85) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "ICU Status") +
      labs(
        title = paste0(g, " Expression by ", tools::toTitleCase(cat_var1),
                       " and ICU Status"),
        subtitle = "Boxplots show median & IQR; points show individual samples",
        x     = tools::toTitleCase(cat_var1),
        y     = paste(g, "Expression")
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, color = "gray30"),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title    = element_text(face = "bold")
      )
    print(p_box)
  }
}

# MERGE EXPRESSION AND METADATA
merged_df <- expr_long %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "participant_id")

# GENERATE ABCA1 PLOTS
plot_gene_plots(
  data      = merged_df,
  gene_list = c("ABCA1"),  # Focus on ABCA1 gene
  cont_var  = "crp",       # Continuous variable
  cat_var1  = "sex",       # Primary categorical
  cat_var2  = "icu_status" # Secondary categorical
)
```

## Heatmap Visualization

```{r heatmap}
# HEATMAP OF TOP VARIABLE GENES
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 1. DATA IMPORT
genes_df  <- read.csv("QBS103_GSE157103_genes.csv", check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1)
series_df <- read.csv("QBS103_GSE157103_series_matrix.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# 2. EXPRESSION MATRIX PREPARATION
expr_mat <- as.data.frame(t(genes_df))  # Transpose to samples x genes
expr_mat <- mutate_all(expr_mat, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Sample alignment
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(expr_mat), series_df$participant_id)
expr_mat   <- expr_mat[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
series_df  <- series_df[match(common_ids, series_df$participant_id), , drop = FALSE]

# 3. METADATA CLEANING
series_df$sex        <- tolower(trimws(series_df$sex))
series_df$icu_status <- tolower(trimws(series_df$icu_status))

# Standardize values
series_df$sex <- case_when(
  series_df$sex == "male"   ~ "Male",
  series_df$sex == "female" ~ "Female",
  TRUE ~ "Unknown"
)

series_df$icu_status <- ifelse(series_df$icu_status == "yes", "ICU", "Non-ICU")

# Prepare annotation data
rownames(series_df) <- series_df$participant_id
anno_row <- series_df[, c("icu_status", "sex"), drop = FALSE]

# Filter unknown genders
keep_idx <- anno_row$sex %in% c("Male", "Female") & !is.na(anno_row$sex)
expr_mat <- expr_mat[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]
anno_row <- droplevels(anno_row[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE])

# 4. SELECT TOP VARIABLE GENES
N <- 10  # Number of top genes to display
gene_vars <- apply(expr_mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
top_genes <- names(sort(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(N, length(gene_vars)))]
expr_mat  <- expr_mat[, top_genes, drop = FALSE]

# 5. MISSING VALUE IMPUTATION
for (i in seq_len(nrow(expr_mat))) {
  if (anyNA(expr_mat[i, ])) {
    row_mean <- mean(expr_mat[i, ], na.rm = TRUE)
    expr_mat[i, is.na(expr_mat[i, ])] <- row_mean
  }
}

# 6. HEATMAP VISUALIZATION
ann_colors <- list(
  icu_status = c("Non-ICU" = "#1f78b4", "ICU" = "#e31a1c"),  # Blue/Red
  sex        = c("Male" = "#33a02c", "Female" = "#6a3d9a")   # Green/Purple
)
colnames(anno_row)[colnames(anno_row) == "icu_status"] <- "ICU status"

pheatmap(
  as.matrix(expr_mat),
  scale = "row",  # Row-normalize (z-score)
  annotation_row = anno_row,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,  # Hide sample names
  show_colnames = TRUE,   # Show gene names
  fontsize = 10,
  border_color = NA,      # No cell borders
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(7, "RdBu")))(100),  # Diverging colors
  main = sprintf("Heatmap of %d Most Variable Genes", N)
)
```

# new plot type

```{r abca1_publication}
# PUBLICATION-QUALITY ABCA1 VISUALIZATION
library(tidyverse)

# 1. DATA PREPARATION (REPEATED FOR COMPLETENESS)
expr_long <- genes_data %>%
  rename(gene = 1) %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "participant_id", values_to = "expression") %>%
  mutate(
    gene = toupper(trimws(gene)),
    expression = as.numeric(expression)
  )

series_matrix_clean <- series_matrix %>%
  mutate(age = parse_number(as.character(age))) %>%
  select(participant_id, age)

df_abca1 <- expr_long %>%
  filter(gene == "ABCA1") %>%
  left_join(series_matrix_clean, by = "participant_id") %>%
  drop_na(age, expression)

# 2. QUANTILE DATA RESHAPING
summ_age_long <- df_abca1 %>%
  group_by(age) %>%
  summarise(
    Q25    = quantile(expression, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = quantile(expression, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q75    = quantile(expression, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Q25, Median, Q75),
               names_to = "Quantile", values_to = "Expression")

segments_df <- summ_age_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Quantile, values_from = Expression) %>%
  select(age, Q25, Q75)

# 3. AESTHETIC MAPPINGS
color_map <- c(
  "Q25" = "#0072B2",      # Blue
  "Q75" = "#D55E00",      # Orange
  "Median" = "black",     # Black
  "Median trend" = "black"
)
fill_map <- c(
  "Q25" = "#0072B2",
  "Q75" = "#D55E00",
  "Median" = "white",
  "Median trend" = NA
)
shape_map <- c(
  "Q25" = 21,  # Filled circle
  "Q75" = 21,
  "Median" = 21,
  "Median trend" = NA
)

# 4. FINAL PLOT CONSTRUCTION
p_abca1 <- ggplot() +
  # Q25-Q75 segments (gray lines)
  geom_segment(data = segments_df,
               aes(x = age, xend = age, y = Q25, yend = Q75),
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 1) +
  # Quantile points
  geom_point(data = summ_age_long,
             aes(x = age, y = Expression,
                 color = Quantile, shape = Quantile, fill = Quantile),
             size = 3, stroke = 0.8) +
  # Median trend line
  geom_smooth(
    data = filter(summ_age_long, Quantile == "Median"),
    aes(x = age, y = Expression),
    color = "black", linetype = "dashed",
    method = "loess", formula = y ~ x,
    linewidth = 1, se = FALSE
  ) +
  # SCALES AND THEMING
  scale_color_manual(
    values = color_map,
    breaks = c("Q25", "Median", "Q75"),
    labels = c("Q25 (25th percentile)", "Median", "Q75 (75th percentile)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map, na.value = NA,
                    breaks = c("Q25", "Median", "Q75")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_map, na.translate = FALSE,
                     breaks = c("Q25", "Median", "Q75")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(20, 90, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 42), breaks = seq(0, 40, 5)) +
  labs(
    title = "ABCA1 Expression by Age",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "ABCA1 Expression Level",
    caption = "Gray lines show Q25-Q75 range. Dashed line shows median trend."
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "gray40", size = 10)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        shape = c(21, 21, 21),
        fill = c("#0072B2", "white", "#D55E00"),
        color = c("#0072B2", "black", "#D55E00"),
        linetype = c(0, 0, 0)
      )
    ),
    shape = "none",
    fill = "none"
  )

# DISPLAY PLOT
print(p_abca1)
```
